text: The Master of Translation (MTI, English Translation) degree authorization program of the School of Foreign Chinese of Wenzhou University was approved by the Ministry of Education in 2021 and is currently the only master's degree in translation in southern Zhejiang, northern Fujian, and eastern Gandong. The training goal is to cultivate and support the leadership of the Communist Party of China, support the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics, love the motherland, establish a correct world view, outlook on life and values, and have a sense of mission and responsibility to devote themselves to building China's international discourse system and enhancing the country's international competitiveness; High-level, application-oriented language translation service talents with broad international vision, strong feelings of home and country, solid bilingual skills in English and Chinese and good professional ethics. His research interests include international business translation and regional cultural translation.
